name: amai-lyrics
description: This extension enhances your Spotify experience by providing line-by-line translations, along with Furigana and Romaji for Japanese lyrics, and Romanization for Korean lyrics.
author: hudzax

scripts.postinstall: node -e "try{const fs=require('fs');const p='node_modules/@hudzax/web-modules/Scheduler.ts';let t=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8');const o=t;t=t.replace(/return \[0, setTimeout/g,'return [0, window.setTimeout').replace(/return \[1, setInterval/g,'return [1, window.setInterval').replace(/scheduled\[1\] = setTimeout/g,'scheduled[1] = window.setTimeout');if(t!==o){fs.writeFileSync(p,t);console.log('[postinstall] Patched Scheduler.ts for DOM setTimeout types')} }catch(e){}"
